risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (327), rising dollar, and recession signals create highly unfavourable conditions for financials despite distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9 rising with supertrend bullish and extreme fear sentiment (24/10) create short-term contrarian opportunity near support at 37.96, with McCaul's $100k-$250k congressional purchase suggesting selective institutional conviction.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 327, inverted yield curve, rising DXY) with price trapped below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF/AO, overbought oscillators, zero fundamental support, and no smart money alignment—technical bounce lacks structural confirmation.
